title: Diplocraft
description: Diplocraft is a modern geopolitical Minecraft server where players build nations, shape international relations, and write the history of a living fictional world through diplomacy, development, trade and conflict.
body:
Diplocraft is a modded Minecraft Java server where diplomacy and nation-building shape the world. Every player has the freedom to forge their own path—whether that's creating a peaceful trading empire, establishing a powerful military state, or becoming the architect of a global alliance.

Build your nation from the ground up using a carefully selected collection of mods, including Create for advanced engineering and automation, Superb Warfare for immersive military gameplay, TACZ Weapons and its extensive submods for modern combat, alongside many other mods that expand industry, infrastructure, exploration, and roleplay.

Diplocraft is a living world driven by its players. Form alliances, negotiate treaties, establish trade routes, participate in political intrigue, or declare war to expand your influence. Every decision leaves a lasting impact on the world and its history.

Whether you aspire to become a respected diplomat, a master engineer, a fearless general, or the ruler of a global superpower, Diplocraft gives you the tools to shape your nation's destiny.

The world is yours to build. The future is yours to decide.
